text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here it is! How's that!? Took a glorious
1st place just for you, Trainer!
Tamamo Cross was overjoyed after winning the Nakayama Kimpai.
That was a little while before I decided to enter the race—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Please, Trainer! Ya gotta enter me
in the Gold Cup!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why, ya ask? 'Cause it's an auspicious race,
obviously!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If I can win there, it'll be super auspicious, right?
Seeing as it's the very first race of the New Year."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wanna blow 'em away with a bang for good luck, ya know?
So it's fine, right? Right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch, Trainer. With this,
I'm sure tons of great things'll happen this year!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
For me, and for you too,
since you're the one who let me run!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And to the folks at Nakayama, here's some
luck to share with you all! Take it!
Tamamo Cross beamed and waved with all her might to the fans packing Nakayama Racecourse.
